entries.name: Droit d'enregistrement (ventes d'immeubles)
entries.doc: art. 273: "Sous réserve des dispositions de l'article 264, les ventes, reventes, cessions, rétrocessions, adjudications de bien immeubles à titre onéreux ... ainsi que les actes translatifs du droit de superficie sur un immeuble, sont assujettis à un droit de 9 %." CGI 2022 edition without the 2023-2025 finance laws: grade B.
notes: CGI 2022 art. 273: 9 % (the art. 264 reservations not read; 2023-2025 finance laws not held)

entries.name: Stamp duty
entries.statute: Code général des impôts 2022 + LF 2024 (archived finances.gouv.km)
entries.why: triage minor: droit de timbre in the francophone codes = fixed stamps per sheet / instrument (dimension, receipts, passports, vehicle papers): no household base in the model; transfers of immovables are carried by the P5 registration (mutation) duties where modelled. listed by the registry (confirmed in reachable text); charging provision not read/modelled in this pass

entries.name: Contribution des patentes, stated profession: wholesale general-merchandise trader in a capital of the islands (150 000 F + 1/10 of rental value + 30 % communal centime)
entries.statute: CGI 2022 (updated to 1 January 2022) art. 165-166, 171, 179, 193 (L.F. 2021) and the annexed tariff ('Marchandises générales (Marchand de) — en gros'); LF 2023-2025 not checked
entries.doc: art. 165: the patente is a fixed duty and a proportional duty under the annexed tariff; art. 166: the fixed duty is set by the activity and reduced by 20 % outside the islands' capitals; art. 171: the proportional duty is on the rental value of the premises; tariff: general-merchandise trader, wholesale, fixed duty 150 000 FC, proportional duty 10e (one tenth of the rental value); art. 193 (L.F. 2021): a communal additional centime of 30 % on the patente. Every company line is taken to be such a trader in Moroni.
unsupported: the trade of the company is not in the input: one stated profession is applied to every company
20 % reduction of the fixed duty outside the islands' capitals (art. 166)
retail traders 50 000 FC and the other activities of the tariff

entries.name: Net wealth tax
entries.why: KM: the general tax code held (cgi2022.txt) has no charging provision on net wealth (full-text search 'impôt sur la fortune / le patrimoine', 'patrimoine net'); edition as held, later finance laws not all checked

entries.name: Prélèvement libératoire sur les plus-values immobilières des personnes physiques (20 %)
entries.statute: CGI 2022 (updated to 1 January 2022) art. 77 2°, 115 (LF 2024 OCR pp. 1-60 held; LF 2023 and 2025 not held)
entries.doc: art. 77 2°: gains made by individuals on built or unbuilt immovables acquired for value or free are property income; art. 115: those gains bear a final levy of 20 %, collected by the registration service when the deed is registered.
unsupported: the gain's computation rules (cost uplift, costs) were not read in the two-column extraction: gain = proceeds − cost − costs

entries.name: Impôt sur la propriété foncière (IPF)
entries.why: art. 192: fixed amounts per building by type — houses with outbuildings 5 000 FC (2 000 m² or more) / 3 000 FC, dwellings without outbuildings 1 000 FC, professional buildings and land by their own scales: the input carries neither the outbuildings nor the surface

entries.name: Vignette automobile et droit de stationnement (vehicles up to 5 years old, by fiscal horsepower, + 1 000 FC parking duty)
entries.statute: CGI 2022 art. 432 (L.F. 2019); LF 2023-2025 not checked; dating for 2025 (seventeenth pass): the LF 2024 OCR held (world/B08-central-africa-fr/km/law/lf2024.ocr1-60.txt, pp. 1-60) shows the vignette only as a budget revenue line (7142), no amendment of art. 432 seen; LF 2023 and LF 2025 not held (flag)
entries.doc: art. 432: vehicles up to 5 years old 0-5 CV 9 000 FC, 6-9 CV 12 000, 10-12 CV 18 000, 12 CV and more 22 500 (6-10 years: 6 000 / 9 000 / 12 000 / 18 000; 11-20 years: 3 000 / 6 000 / 9 000 / 12 000), and a parking duty of 1 000 FC per car, added here to each amount. The vehicle's age is not in the input: vehicles are taken to be at most 5 years old.
